title: Shopify mandate stub report (digital-product pilot)
description: Env-gated stub for a future Shopify-bound mandate path. Unset or blank SHOPIFY_STORE_URL is a no-op. A set value is validated as https with no userinfo and is never fetched. The stub does not invent a store URL, does not complete checkout, and is not a Done predicate. Operator env only — never a signed-mandate field.

kind.description: Stub report domain. An observation receipt or shopping mandate is not this document.

live_store.description: This increment never contacts a live store.

fetched.description: The stub never fetches. A configured URL is not a retrieval.

invented.description: No default store URL is synthesized. Only SHOPIFY_STORE_URL is read.

armed.description: true only when a valid https store URL is configured. Armed is still a no-op for live work.

ok.description: false only when the env is set and the value is not a usable https URL.

enabled.description: true only when a valid https store URL is configured. Never implies a live call.

checkout_approved.description: The stub cannot approve checkout. Human merchant-checkout stays on the offers rail.
